claims.text: The Main Grants fund supports research addressing priority questions from the Foundation’s Strategic Review.
The Main Grants fund offers up to £500,000 per award.
There are two application deadlines per year for the Main Grants fund: Spring and Autumn.
In special cases, applications for up to £750,000 are accepted by prior agreement.
Most awarded grants are below £300,000.
The outline application deadline is 5 October 2026.
The fund prioritizes proposals that address one or more of five priority questions.
The fund assesses proposals based on relevance, impact, conceptual framework, rigour, experience, and value for money.
Individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for the project duration are not eligible.
Projects led by individuals unaffiliated to any organization are not funded.
Projects led by schools or further education colleges are not funded.
Projects led by undergraduates or master’s students are not funded.
PhD fees or projects whose main purpose is to support a PhD are not funded.
The establishment of academic posts is not funded.
Ongoing costs or costs of 'rolling out' existing work or services are not funded unless explicitly agreed in advance.
'Dissemination-only' projects, including campaigning work not connected to funded work, are not funded.
Local charities, replacement for statutory funding, or local social services or social welfare provision are not funded.
Requests for financial help or educational fees from or on behalf of individuals are not funded.
Projects led by organizations or institutions not based in the UK are not funded.
In exceptional cases, applications from overseas organizations may be accepted if no UK-based host is feasible, provided strong plans for UK-focused dissemination, engagement, and impact are shown.
